entries.topic: The lenses' own sources: Tolkien naming, the palantiri, Apocryphon of John, Monroe's loosh, the Emerald Tablet; documented stress outcomes

claims.text: Quartz: at least five Thiel-linked entities carry Tolkien names: Palantir Technologies (the seeing stones), Valar Ventures (registered NZ 2009; the powers that shaped Middle-earth), Mithril Capital (2012; partner Ajay Royan said the metal 'protects' and is 'transformative'), Rivendell One LLC and Lembas LLC (vehicles in a 2016 SEC filing used to sell Facebook shares); correction: Anduril is not a Thiel company — Founders Fund invested, deal led by Brian Singerman; article does not say who chose each name
Capital & Main: Thiel 'spent his teenage years reading and rereading' The Lord of the Rings; Palantir's Palo Alto offices informally known as 'The Shire'; Palmer Luckey named Anduril after the sword
LitHub (2026): Thiel told The Atlantic in 2023 he had read the series at least a dozen times (paraphrase); companies named in homage incl. Palantir, Mithril, Valar, Lembas, Rivendell One

Palantiri in Tolkien: seeing-stones made by the Elves (Feanor), used by Men; the Orthanc-stone beguiled Saruman; Sauron, holding the Ithil-stone, used it to deceive enemies, subvert Saruman and drive Denethor to despair, influencing his perception that Gondor's defeat was inevitable; Denethor burned himself holding the Anor-stone; the Orthanc-stone later used by Gandalf and Aragorn against Sauron

Britannica: Apocryphon of John — three copies among Nag Hammadi codices found 1945 (probably 4th century), a fourth in Berlin Codex 8502; creator of the visible world Ialdabaoth, 'a lesser being, a ruler (archon)', 'unaware of any power above him', rules the cosmos 'with subordinate powers who are his own imperfect offspring'; material realm 'a copy of the perfect spiritual realm'; birth entails 'a forgetting of that divine origin'

Robert Monroe (1915-1995), radio broadcasting executive; Journeys Out of the Body (1971), Far Journeys (1985), Ultimate Journey (1994); coined 'loosh' for 'a type of energy' created by beings experiencing intense fear, grief or despair, harvested by non-human beings who control reality (Far Journeys p.183); claims not scientifically established

Emerald Tablet: oldest text Arabic, appendix to the Book of the Secret of Creation (late 8th/early 9th c.); Latin vulgate 12th c. 'Quod est superius est sicut quod inferius'; Newton: 'That which is below is like that which is above'; 'as above, so below' is a paraphrase popularised by Blavatsky

KFF/NYT 2025 Survey of Immigrants (28 Aug-20 Oct 2025, n=1,805): 41% fear they or a family member could be detained or deported (26% in 2023), rising most among lawfully present immigrants and naturalized citizens; 30% avoid travel, work, public spaces or medical care (75% of likely undocumented); skipped/postponed care 22% to 29%; 40% report negative health impacts incl. stress, anxiety or sadness (77% of likely undocumented)

Prevention Through Deterrence: US Border Patrol policy introduced in the 'Border Patrol Strategic Plan of 1994 and Beyond' (origins in Operation Blockade, El Paso, Sept-Oct 1993) to deter illegal crossings by concentrating enforcement in urban areas, pushing crossings into remote terrain; used since

entries.topic: Objective-C runtime patterns used as a lens

claims.text: Apple: 'In Objective-C, messages aren't bound to method implementations until runtime'; the compiler converts [receiver message] 'into a call on a messaging function, objc_msgSend'; it looks up the selector in the class 'dispatch table'; runtime caches selectors and addresses

Apple: before an error the runtime gives the receiver 'a second chance'; forwardInvocation: 'commonly used to forward the message to another object'; return value returned to the original sender; forwarding is 'transparent to the message sender'; a surrogate 'stands in for the other object and funnels messages to it'; respondsToSelector: on the forwarder returns NO

Apple: NSProxy is 'An abstract superclass defining an API for objects that act as stand-ins for other objects or for objects that don't exist yet'; a message to a proxy is forwarded to the real object; used for transparent distributed messaging
Apple: KVO 'is a mechanism that allows objects to be notified of changes to specified properties of other objects'; no central object; notifications sent directly to observers

Apple: automatic KVO uses isa-swizzling; registering an observer changes the observed object's isa pointer to an intermediate, dynamically generated class; the class method still returns the true class

Apple: +load is 'Invoked whenever a class or category is added to the Objective-C runtime'; order: linked frameworks' initializers, then all +load methods in the image, then C++ static initializers; a class's +load runs after its superclasses'
NSHipster: method swizzling 'lets you swap the implementations of two methods'; uses method_exchangeImplementations; Mattt's advice that swizzling 'should always be done in load()'

sources.label: Apple, Objective-C Runtime Programming Guide, 'Message Forwarding'
